dis.text: Augustin IV is the Azorius Grand Arbiter, in whose senate chamber Modar Bejiri receives his field hussar's brooch, and he speaks of a peace that is gentle yet unstoppable.
He tells Kos that he broke the Guildpact by arresting Szadek, and Evern warns them that Momir Vig and the Simic are working with the God-Zombie Svogthir in Savra's body.

Augustin reveals he took control of the captured Szadek because he wants a new Ravnica where everyone follows the law, but Szadek, released from Kos's grounder, sucks his soul out just before the Parhelion explodes.
